title: Draft Comprehensive README.md
description: Create a detailed and well-structured README.md at the project root to guide new developers through understanding, setting up, and deploying the CodeGuide project.
details: Write a README.md file with the following sections: Project Title, About The Project, Key Features, Tech Stack, Getting Started, Environment Variables, Deployment, and Table of Contents. Include badges (build status, license, version) at the top. Use Markdown formatting for clarity. Provide links to official documentation for major technologies used. Ensure all instructions are clear, concise, and copy-paste friendly. Reference the repository structure and key files as outlined in the PRD.
test_strategy: Review the README for completeness, clarity, and formatting. Ensure all sections are present and instructions are unambiguous. Peer review for accuracy and developer-friendliness.

title: Create .env.example File
description: Generate a .env.example file at the project root listing all required environment variables with placeholder values.
details: Identify all environment variables needed for local development and production (e.g., database connection strings, Better Auth secrets). Document each variable with a brief comment if necessary. Ensure the example file matches the variables referenced in the README setup instructions.
test_strategy: Compare .env.example with the codebase and README to ensure all required variables are included and correctly named. Attempt to start the project using a .env.local copied from .env.example to verify completeness.

title: Validate Setup Instructions via Clean-Room Test
description: Test the accuracy of the README and .env.example by performing a clean-room setup of the project from scratch.
details: Clone the repository into a new directory. Follow only the steps in the README to install dependencies, configure environment variables, run database migrations, and start the development server. Note any missing or unclear steps and update the documentation as needed.
test_strategy: If the application installs, builds, and runs successfully without referencing external knowledge, the documentation is validated. Otherwise, iterate on the README and .env.example until the process is seamless.

title: Document Docker and Deployment Instructions
description: Expand the README with clear instructions for building and running the project using Docker, and for deploying to platforms like Vercel.
details: Add a Deployment section to the README. Include step-by-step Docker build and run commands, and explain how to configure environment variables for Docker. Provide a brief guide for deploying to Vercel, including environment variable setup and any platform-specific considerations. Reference the Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml as needed.
test_strategy: Follow the Docker and deployment instructions on a fresh environment to ensure the application builds and runs as described. Peer review for clarity and completeness.
